function.description: Authenticate a user by their credentials and return an authentication token. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

remember_me.description: A flag indicating whether the user's session should be remembered across browser restarts.

login_attempts.description: The number of consecutive failed login attempts. After a certain threshold, additional verification may be required.

I don’t have real‑time data, so I can’t give you the current temperature or forecast for London right now. However, here’s a quick snapshot of what you can generally expect:

| Season | Typical Temperature (°C) | Typical Weather |
|--------|--------------------------|-----------------|
| Winter (Dec–Feb) | 0 – 7 °C | Overcast, light rain, occasional snow |
| Spring (Mar–May) | 7 – 15 °C | Mild, increasing sunshine, occasional showers |
| Summer (Jun–Aug) | 15 – 25 °C | Warm, sunny days, occasional heatwaves |
| Autumn (Sep–Nov) | 10 – 15 °C | Cooler, more rain, crisp evenings |

If you need the current weather, you can check a reliable weather service like the UK Met Office, BBC Weather, or a weather app on your phone. Let me know if you’d like a quick guide on how to set up a weather alert or anything else!
